responsibility: Declares the analyzer’s diagnostic path event hierarchy layered on GCC’s diagnostic_event API. It defines event_loc_info, the event_kind discriminator, the checker_event base class with inlining-aware location/depth handling, and the concrete event classes used to describe statements, region creation, function entry, CFG and call/return edges, state changes, setjmp/longjmp rewinds, reconstructed inlined calls, and final warnings.
same_name_distinction: Declares the analyzer-specific diagnostic event class hierarchy, event_kind enum, and shared event state used by checker paths, whereas checker-event.cc defines how those event classes behave and render messages.
